This [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] '''tribe''' was led by [[Iziz (Jawa)/Legends|Iziz]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Several members of the tribe were enslaved by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]], and Iziz asked [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] for help but they refused. Iziz later asked the amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] for help, who accepted on the terms that the Jawa would lead [[Gender/Legends|him]] to the [[Star Map]]. Revan spoke to the [[Sand People chieftain]] with the assistance of [[HK-47]] and negotiated their release.
